articles.title: OpenAI Parts Ways With Three Safety Researchers Over Sensitive Information Mishandling
articles.summary:

articles.title: Android 17 Advanced Protection Locks Accessibility Services to Verified Accessibility Tools
articles.summary:
Google has announced a new security measure that limits access to Android's accessibility services to verified applications classified as Accessibility Tools when Advanced Protection is enabled.

articles.summary:
